_comment: Curated TKE (Kubernetes worker node) risk overrides for RHEL9-CIS. Control ids follow the RHEL9 benchmark numbering (e.g. ip_forward is 3.3.1, not 3.3.1.1). The role-native levers (rhel9cis_is_router, rhel9cis_firewall, rhel9cis_selinux_enforce) match RHEL10's intent. Derived from analysing the RHEL9-CIS role tasks.

3.3.1.reason: Disables IP forwarding (net.ipv4.ip_forward and IPv6). kube-proxy and every CNI require ip_forward=1 for pod/Service routing.

1.1.2.4.2.reason: Adds nodev to /var. kubelet/containerd operate under /var/lib; relaxed to be safe.

1.1.2.4.3.reason: Adds nosuid to /var. Can affect some CSI/CNI helper binaries under /var/lib.

1.1.2.1.4.reason: Adds noexec to /tmp. Kubernetes does not exec from /tmp, but some bootstrap/Helm hooks might.

4.reason: firewalld with the default zone blocks kubelet (10250), NodePort (30000-32767), and CNI overlay traffic.
4.note: TKE worker nodes are fronted by a Tencent Security Group, which is the enforced network boundary.

rhel9cis_selinux_enforce.reason: SELinux enforcing may block containerd/kubelet without validated contexts.

rhel9cis_is_router.reason: Primary lever to keep IPv4+IPv6 forwarding on for kube-proxy/CNI.
